article: Install apps from the command line with WinGet
scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Checked commands, current OS support, App Installer guidance, package ID/source semantics, internal/external links, and localized prose.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date, restored the original publication date (2022-10-05), and set lastmod to the review date in all 13 editions.
Updated supported platforms from Windows 11 only to Windows 11, Windows 10 version 1809 or later, and Windows Server 2025 per Microsoft Learn.
Replaced the stale fixed app list with search/show guidance and package IDs documented by Microsoft; clarified exact matching, source selection, and agreement prompts.
Corrected the Paint.NET aside: the current WinGet community repository lists dotPDN.PaintDotNet and the article now shows how to inspect/install it.
Removed the malformed Docker nested link and replaced outdated references with Microsoft Learn and the current Paint.NET manifest.
